The expected impact is more predictable revenue and long-term, sustainable ARR growth. • With the impact of the actions above, SoundHound expects the 2026 revenue to be in the range of $250M - $260M, and 2027 revenue in the range of $350M - $400M. • SoundHound expects to reach sustained adjusted EBITDA positive within the second half of 2027, even at the lower-end of its revenue guidance.
